questions.question: Three years ago, the difference between the age of Ravish and the age of Kailash was 18 years. Three years from today, Ravish will be three times as old as Kailash. What is the present age of Ravish (in years)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Three years from today, Ravish will be three times as old as Kailash.

So, Age of Ravish = 3 × Age of Kailash

Let, age of Kailash = x and age of Ravish = 3x.

**We know that, difference between the age of two persons always remains same.**

As, three years ago, the difference between the age of Ravish and the age of Kailash was 18 years. So, after three years the difference between the age of Ravish and the age of Kailash will 18 years.

According to the question, 

Age of Ravish - Age of Kailash = 18

⇒ 3x - x = 18

⇒ 2x = 18

⇒ **x = 9**

Therefore, age of Ravish = 3x = 3 × 9 = 27 year [**After three years]** 

**So, present age of Ravish is 27 - 3 = 24 year.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"24".**

questions.question: ______ is an environmental policy under which producers are given a significant responsibility - financial and/or physical - for the treatment or disposal of products that are no longer useful to the consumer.
questions.solution:
__**Concept:**__

**Environmental policy:**

__
 
• It is a kind of **measure** or unit that is taken by a** different kind of organization** like government and private regarding a **different kind of effect of human activities on the environment.**
 
• This is majorly created for the **prevention of human-made effects on the ecosystem.**
 
• Different kinds of environmental policies are ecosystem management, waste management, natural resources protection, and biodiversity conservation.

**Explanation:**__

**Extended Producer Responsibility:**

__
 
• This policy's concept was first introduced by the **Swedish Ministry of Environment in 1990.**
 
• Today's world is facing an increasing amount of waste and its effect on the environment.
 
• Different governments around the world are trying to control this problem with the post-consumer phase by environmental policy.
 
• The correct answer is Extended Producer Responsibility.
 
• EPR refers to an environmental policy that sees producers responsible for the safe disposal of their products.
 
• It is the responsibility, that the waste generated during the production processes should be taken care of in a proper way, from an environmental and resource-saving point of view.
 
• Before the manufacturing of a product is commenced it should be known how the waste, which is a result of the production process, should be treated, as well as how the product should be taken care of when discarded.
 
• The ultimate goal of EPR is sustainable development through environmentally responsible product development and product recovery.
 
• Its main objective is to divert and reduce waste.
 
• Here **producers** of a product **take full responsibility for their products' whole lifecycle **including recycling, reuse, final disposal, and packaging.

**Thus, extended producer responsibility is an environmental policy under which producers are given a significant responsibility - financial and/or physical - for the treatment or disposal of products that are no longer useful to the consumer.**__

questions.question: The average of twelve numbers is 42. The average of the last five numbers is 40, and that of the first four numbers is 44. The sixth number is 6 less than the fifth number and 5 less than the seventh number. The average of the sixth and seventh numbers is:

__Shortcut Trick__

Net deviation of first 4 numbers = 4 × (44 − 42) = +8

Net deviation of last 5 numbers = 5 × (40 − 42) = −10

Sum of 5th, 6th, and 7th numbers = (3 × 42) − (8 − 10) = 126 + 2 = 128

Let 6th number be x, then (x + 6) + x + (x + 5) = 128 ⇒ 3x = 117 ⇒ x = 39

Average of 6th (39) and 7th (44) = (39 + 44) ÷ 2 = 41.5

**∴ The correct option is D.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average of 12 numbers = 42

Average of first 4 numbers = 44

Average of last 5 numbers = 40

6th number is 6 less than 5th and 5 less than 7th.

**Formula Used:**

Sum = Average × Number of observations

 
 
 
 First 4 (Avg 44)
 5, 6, 7 (Avg ?)
 Last 5 (Avg 40)
 Total of 12 Numbers (Avg 42)
 
• 
 Remaining Sum (5th+6th+7th) = 128

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total sum of 12 numbers = 12 × 42 = 504

⇒ Sum of first 4 numbers = 4 × 44 = 176

⇒ Sum of last 5 numbers = 5 × 40 = 200

⇒ Sum of 5th, 6th, and 7th numbers = 504 − (176 + 200) = 504 − 376 = 128

⇒ Let 6th number = x

⇒ 5th number = x + 6

⇒ 7th number = x + 5

⇒ 3x + 11 = 128 ⇒ 3x = 117 ⇒ x = 39

⇒ 6th number = 39, 7th number = 39 + 5 = 44

⇒ Average of 6th and 7th numbers = (39 + 44) ÷ 2 = 83 ÷ 2 = 41.5

**∴ The correct option is D.**

**__Additional Information__**

Average Concept

The sum of deviations of all observations from the actual mean is always zero. This property helps in finding missing values quickly.

questions.question: A and B entered into a partnership with certain investments. At the end of 8 months, A withdrew and collected back his money. A and B received profit in the ratio 5 ∶ 9 at the end of the year. If B had invested Rs. 36,000, then how much (in Rs.) had A invested?

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Profit Ratio = (InvestmentA × TimeA) : (InvestmentB × TimeB)

5 : 9 = (IA × 8) : (36,000 × 12)

IA = (5 ÷ 9) × (36,000 × 12 ÷ 8)

IA = 5 × 4,000 × 1.5 = 30,000

**∴ The correct answer is 30,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Investment of B = Rs. 36,000 | Time for A = 8 months | Time for B = 12 months | Profit Ratio A : B = 5 : 9

Formula Used: Profit = Investment × Time

⇒ ProfitA ÷ ProfitB = (InvA × TimeA) ÷ (InvB × TimeB)

⇒ 5 ÷ 9 = (IA × 8) ÷ (36,000 × 12)

⇒ 5 ÷ 9 = (8 × IA) ÷ 432,000

⇒ 8 × IA × 9 = 5 × 432,000

⇒ 72 × IA = 2,160,000

⇒ IA = 2,160,000 ÷ 72

⇒ IA = 30,000

**∴ The correct answer is 30,000.**

Profit Distribution Rule

In any partnership, the ratio of profits is directly proportional to the product of capital invested and the time duration: P₁ : P₂ = C₁T₁ : C₂T₂.

Capital Calculation

If profits and time periods are known, the ratio of investments is: C₁ : C₂ = (P₁/T₁) : (P₂/T₂).

Working vs Sleeping Partner

A working partner manages the business and may receive a salary or fixed percentage of profit before the remaining profit is divided based on the investment ratio.

According to the question-

r = radius of wire
